# `Q-3-35` — Unprocessed Highlight Markup

> Highlight editorial markup `[!! ...]` was not desugared to a
> Span during postprocessing.

## What this means

Quarto's CriticMarkup-inspired highlight construct `[!! ...]`
is parsed as a `Highlight` AST node. Postprocessing rewrites
it as a `Span` with the `.quarto-highlight` class before the writer runs.
This error fires when a raw `Highlight` node reaches the
writer.

This is a defensive guard. The condition is a pipeline bug, not
a source-level mistake.

## Why this happens

Two known triggers:

- **A Lua filter ran after postprocessing** and reintroduced a
  `Highlight` AST node.
- **A bug in the postprocessor** that misses some highlights.

## How to fix

If a custom filter is in use, ensure it does not produce
`Highlight` AST nodes after postprocessing. If no filter is in
use, report the document at the Quarto issue tracker.

## Related

- `Q-3-33`, `Q-3-34`, `Q-3-36` — same condition for `Insert`,
  `Delete`, and `EditComment` markup respectively.
